{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 0.50

|eff= local

|gr1= Event Handlers

|descr= Removes all mission event handlers of the given type which were added by [[addMissionEventHandler]].

{{Feature | important | Prior to {{GVI|arma3|2.08}} this command would also reset the Event Handler creation index to 0.}}

|s1= [[removeAllMissionEventHandlers]] type

|p1= type: [[String]]

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>removeAllMissionEventHandlers "Loaded";</sqf>

|seealso= [[removeMissionEventHandler]] [[addMissionEventHandler]]
}}
